description: An animated blank panel of coloured blocks flocking by the Craig Reynolds boids algorithm, resizable by dragging its edge
notes: placed beside another Photron Panel or a Photron Strip, the two blend their colours
holding D and clicking draws on the panel
initialising the module sets the colours purple, blue, aqua and red from top to bottom, and randomising it scrambles every colour
menu: Processing rate — how often the animation is redrawn: 60 Hz, 45 Hz, 30 Hz, 20 Hz, 15 Hz, 12 Hz or 10 Hz, a lower rate asking less of the processor and slowing the animation
Mode — color, black & white, solid color or strip
Light — in solid color and strip modes, one slider sets the pulse speed in Hz, 0Hz staying fully on, and a second sets the hue from 0 to 360 degrees
Dark Room Blobs — draws slow dark shapes over the animation
